title: Nazi Zombie Rave
author: mapper247

scanner.why: crawler_round_ending, end_game name an ending and are this map's own; script hardcodes cost 25000

baseline.note: A name counts as this map's own only if it is absent from WaW's own zone files AND from the boilerplate shared by most maps in the corpus. Built by archive/stock_baseline.py and fed to scan_map.scan(baseline_path=..., ignore=...).

archive.catalogue_description: Description This is a smaller Der Riese style map based off of Verruckt. Features: Moving Pandora box Perks-a-Cola Electro-Shock-Defense Power Ups Power Switch Working teleporters with fx Buyable ending (25,000) No Dogs Update: It has been almost two years since the first release, but I removed most of the bugs and finished detailing the map. I removed the broken sawed-off shotgun, clipped off the first room, and clipped off the “safe zones” behind the shelves next to the stairs. Sadly I could not fix the zombie glitch on the first floor after the second blocker. As for detailing the map, I added a third window barrier in the start zone, added lights with working fx around the map, added a destroyed wall on second floor, and lastly I fixed the reflection problem with the glowing pack a punch door.

notes: Replaces common scripts (maps/_callbackglobal.gsc, maps/_gameskill.gsc, maps/_laststand.gsc, maps/_load.gsc, maps/_loadout.gsc); re-verify the generic down/revive/score events on it. Ships 2 executable(s): $PLUGINSDIR/System.dll, $PLUGINSDIR/nsDialogs.dll. NEVER RUN THEM (dev-box.md rule 3). PROVISIONAL: archive/corpus-ignore.json was missing, so corpus boilerplate was not subtracted and this finish may be a shared-script name; scan_maps.py --keep-existing rewrites this manifest.
